content: In case of calling any subsequent function of Dem_SetDTC- Filter (see [SWS_Dem_00057]) after the initial Dem_SetDTCFilter did not return E_OK, the Dem shall shall return E_NOT_OK on this subsequent function call.

In case of calling any subsequent function of Dem_SetDTC- Filter (see [SWS_Dem_00057]) after the initial Dem_SetDTCFilter did not return E_OK, the Dem shall shall return E_NOT_OK on this subsequent function call.
If any of the APIs depending on a set DTC filter is called while the call to set the DTC filter did not return E_OK, the Dem shall return E_NOT_OK on this subsequent function call.
